meta.title: 传统企业数字化转型的三个诉求
meta.title_en: The Three Demands Behind Enterprise Digital Transformation

scenes.title_cn: 第一条忠告：级别太低，别去
scenes.title_en: Rule one: if the level is too low, don't go
scenes.context: 开篇给出忠告：没能力或道德感太高的人别做数字化转型。传统企业数字化转型有三大诉求，第一个是响应国家政策、规避风险，本质是政治工程，去了也只是做界面和配置。
sentences: 没这个能力的人、道德感要求太高的人，别去做数字化转型。
If you lack the skills — or your standards are too high — don't take a digital transformation job.
道德感要求太高：standards too high
传统企业数字化转型，其实有三个诉求。
Digital transformation in traditional companies really comes down to three demands.
有三个诉求：comes down to three demands
第一个诉求是响应国家政策、规避风险，说白了是个政治工程。
The first is responding to national policy and avoiding risk — in plain terms, it's a political project.
说白了：in plain terms
paraphrase: If the position is too junior, don't take it.
响应政策 → 政治工程
Meeting policy demands makes it a political project.
scenes.speak: If you lack the skills — or your standards are too high — don't take a digital transformation job. You see, digital transformation in traditional companies really comes down to three demands. The first is responding to national policy and avoiding risk — in plain terms, it's a political project.

scenes.title_en: The second demand: cut costs and raise efficiency
scenes.context: 第二个诉求是降本增效：集团做大了，受新兴经济体和竞对冲击，人力与消耗庞大，需要数字化提升整体透明度、节省费用、减少人力。
sentences: 第二个是降本增效：集团做大了，受到新兴经济体的冲击，竞对也起来了。
The second is cutting costs and raising efficiency: as the group grew, it got hit by emerging economies and rising competitors.
降本增效：cut costs and raise efficiency
大量的人力、大量的消耗，都需要靠数字化提升整体透明度。
With heavy labor costs and heavy consumption, digitalization is needed to improve overall transparency.
整体透明度：overall transparency
怎么节省费用、减少人力，就是他们的第二个诉求。
How to cut expenses and reduce headcount — that's their second demand.
减少人力：reduce headcount
paraphrase: 集团大了 → 必须降本
The bigger the group, the more it needs to cut costs.
Transparency means seeing the whole picture.
scenes.speak: The second demand is cutting costs and raising efficiency. As the group grew, it got hit by emerging economies and rising competitors. With heavy labor costs and heavy consumption, digitalization is needed to improve overall transparency — and figuring out how to cut expenses and reduce headcount is exactly what the second demand is about.

scenes.title_cn: 第三个诉求：管理者的安全感
scenes.title_en: The third demand: management's sense of security
scenes.context: 第三个诉求是管理者安全感：公司大了，高管看不清下面的真实情况，需要数据做评估。但财务是财务口径、业务反馈又自说自话，导致打分评定时缺少数据佐证。
sentences: 第三个诉求，其实是管理者安全感的问题。
The third demand is really about management's sense of security.
安全感：sense of security
过去靠财务数据反馈，可财务是财务口径，跟真实的业务口径不一样。
In the past, finance reported the numbers — but finance uses a financial lens, not the real business lens.
财务口径：a financial lens
管理者打分、横向比较、做具体评定时，常常缺少数据佐证和维度。
When managers score people, compare departments, or make specific evaluations, they often lack the data and dimensions to back it up.
数据佐证：data to back it up
paraphrase: 财务口径 → 不等于业务真相
Financial numbers don't equal business reality.
自说自话 → 缺客观佐证
scenes.speak: The third demand is really about management's sense of security. In the past, finance reported the numbers — but finance uses a financial lens, not the real business lens. So when managers score people, compare departments, or make specific evaluations, they often lack the data and dimensions to back it up.

scenes.title_cn: 最后的警告：汇报线要有实权
scenes.title_en: The final warning: your reporting line needs real power
scenes.context: 三大诉求都会影响落地方案：整合原有系统、采购第三方或自研。但无论哪种，数字化转型都是自上而下的工程；级别低就只会沦为做面板、取数的 IT 部门，所以一定要确认汇报线有实权。
sentences: 第一种满足标准，就把原有信息化系统整合起来，用大系统连成一体。
To meet the standards, you integrate existing IT systems and link them up with one big platform.
整合起来：integrate ... and link them up
你以为你在做数字化转型，其实只是给业务做可视化面板、取个数。
You think you're driving transformation — in reality you're just building dashboards and pulling numbers for the business.
可视化面板：dashboard
你一定要搞清楚：你的汇报线，有没有实权推动整个公司的数字化转型。
You must find out one thing: does your reporting line actually have the power to drive company-wide transformation?
汇报线：reporting line
paraphrase: 不同诉求 → 不同落地方式
Different demands lead to different implementation paths.
自上而下 → 汇报线必须有权
Top-down change only works if your reporting line has real power.
scenes.speak: To meet the standards, you integrate existing IT systems and link them up with one big platform. But here's the trap: you think you're driving transformation — in reality you're just building dashboards and pulling numbers for the business. So you must find out one thing: does your reporting line actually have the power to drive company-wide transformation?

practice: Let me give you some straight advice.
If the position is too junior, just don't take it.
表达「自说自话、报喜不报忧」
Everyone just reports the numbers that flatter themselves.
Does your role actually have the authority to make things happen?
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Reduce human / reduce labor force.
✓ 地道说法：Reduce headcount / cut down on staffing.
「减少人力」在职场语境里更常说 headcount 或 staffing，reduce human 是典型中式英语。
✕ 直译腔：Finance is a finance mouth.
✓ 地道说法：Finance uses a financial lens.
「口径」不能直译成 mouth / caliber，用 lens 或 perspective 表示看问题的角度。
✓ 地道说法：Everyone reports the numbers that flatter themselves.
「自说自话」在这里是「自己报自己好听的数」，不能按字面翻成自言自语。
✕ 直译腔：Take out a number for them.
✓ 地道说法：Pull the numbers / run a query for them.
「取个数」在数据语境下更常说 pull the numbers 或 run a query。
shifts: 以为数字化转型是技术活
发现它首先是组织与权力的问题
以为「响应诉求」就是做系统
发现三大诉求背后全是高管和政治
以为进去了就能推动变革
发现级别低就只是给业务打杂的 IT 部门
